mapper.select:
select `cci`.`id` as `couponId`, max(`ca`.`crt_id`) as `submitUserId`, `ca`.`crt_time` as `submitDate`, `cci`.`name` as `couponName`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, sum(`ca`.`allocate_num`) as `allocateNum`, max(`ca`.`allocate_user_id`) as `allocateUserId`, max(`ca`.`allocate_date`) as `allocateDate` from `coupon_common_info` `cci` inner join `coupon_allocate` `ca` on `ca`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1
and `cci`.`name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `cci`.`type` in
#{item}
group by `ca`.`coupon_id`, `ca`.`crt_time` order by `ca`.`crt_time` desc
